channel.title: Nora Fu's Art | 瓜瓜的画
channel.description: Art by Nora Fu — marker and watercolor works from 2020 onwards.

item.title: ants crossing the ocean | 蚂蚁过海
item.description: ants sailing on leaves to cross the ocean. | 蚂蚁们乘着叶子船，穿越大海。

item.title: cool peppers | 辣椒们的海滩时光
item.description: orange and red peppers chilling on the beach. | 辣椒们在海滩上玩耍。

item.title: wake up onion | 洋葱快起床
item.description: veggie friends wanted to play with onion. | 蔬菜伙伴们叫洋葱起床玩耍。

item.title: snail's beach time | 蜗牛的海滩时光
item.description: the snail is having a relaxing time on a beautiful island. | 蜗牛享受着它的海滩慢时光。

item.title: dancing potatoes | 舞动的土豆
item.description: me: "Nora, are these... bacteria?" Nora: "No! They're potatoes! They're dancing!" | 我：“瓜瓜，这些是细菌吗？” 瓜瓜：“不是！它们是土豆！它们在跳舞！”

item.title: dali's time pieces | 达利的表
item.description: dali made flowing time pieces. i did too. | 达利模仿画。

item.title: pokemon dream | 神奇宝贝之梦
item.description: fennekin and her fancy castle. | 火狐狸和她的魔法宫殿。

item.title: happy onions | 快乐的洋葱
item.description: happy onions are a plate, playing with fruit friends | 快乐的洋葱们一家在餐桌的盘子上，和水果朋友打招呼。

item.title: fish in the fire sea | 火焰海里的小鱼
item.description: colorful fish are swimming in a dark blue sea under a fiery orange sky. | 五颜六色的小鱼在深蓝色的大海里游泳，天空燃烧着橙色的火焰。

item.title: big fish are hunting small fish | 大鱼吃小鱼
item.description: the whale and the anglerfish are waiting for small fish to slow down. | 鲸鱼和安康鱼在等待机会吃小鱼。

item.title: black bottles and brown bottles | 黑瓶子棕瓶子
item.description: different bottles are waiting for different flower friends. | 瓶子们在等花儿朋友们来。

item.title: sweet things in life | 甜甜的
item.description: a still life drawing of a cup of mac n cheese, my water bottle and my fav sweets. | 画了通心粉杯子、水壶和巧克力，都是让我开心的东西。

item.title: self-portrait | 我的自画像
item.description: this is my self-portrait. i don't look happy because i have a cold. | 感冒了，画里的我看起来有点没精神。

item.title: fruit on the table | 桌子上的水果
item.description: kiwi, orange, apple and cherries are happily waiting for someone to eat them. | 猕猴桃，橙子，苹果还有樱桃开心地等着被吃掉。

item.title: the itsy bitsy spider | 蜘蛛织网
item.description: an eight-legged spider busy spinning her web. | 八条腿的小蜘蛛正在角落里忙碌地织网。

item.title: mushroom cafe | 蘑菇咖啡馆
item.description: this is my mushroom cafe on earth. the happy mushrooms serve coffee and sweets. | 我在地球上开了一家蘑菇咖啡店，蘑菇们会做各种好喝的饮料和甜品。

item.title: the starry night | 流动的夜空
item.description: a dragon lives in the black castle. at night, he feels lonely and uses magic to make the sky flow like a river. | 住在黑城堡的龙有点寂寞，于是它用魔法让天空像河流一样闪闪发光。

item.title: dinosaur shower | 给恐龙洗澡
item.description: me and my friends giving dippi and psittacosaurus a good bath washing off dirt (not poop). we are wearing red because it's chinese new year. | 我和朋友们帮迪皮和鹦鹉龙好好洗澡，我们穿着新年红衣服。

item.title: gravity | 掉落的苹果
item.description: bob with long hair bumped the tree and made the apple fall on isaac newton's head. | 长头发的鲍勃撞到树，让苹果砸到了牛顿头上！牛顿想 "苹果为什么会掉下来而不是飞上天呢？"

item.title: the eiffel tower in a storm | 雷雨中的埃菲尔铁塔
item.description: lightning bolts are striking all around the eiffel tower during a big storm. | 埃菲尔铁塔四周电闪雷鸣，暴风雨来了。

item.title: the owl | 猫头鹰
item.description: an owl flying over the sea to get fish | 猫头鹰在大海上飞行，找鱼吃。

item.title: neighborhood | 街景
item.description: street houses near my art classroom | 我画了我的画画教室对面的街景。

item.title: cactus | 仙人掌
item.description: happy cactus dancing around | 这群快乐的仙人掌在大太阳下跳舞。

item.title: moon river | 月亮河
item.description: it's mid-autumn day. i'm rowing in front of the moon. i watch lanterns rising from the river and lighting up the sky. | 中秋节那天，我划船看月亮，河里飘着慢慢升空的灯笼非常美丽。

item.title: eating watermelon | 吃西瓜
item.description: me and my friends (Juna, Bella and Jocelyn) eating watermelon | 我和朋友们在吃西瓜。

item.title: singing with my friends | 一起唱歌
item.description: i'm singing karaoke with my friends. the song is 'we can have fun!' | 我和朋友们一起唱卡拉ok。我唱了 "我们一起嗨！"

item.title: self-portrait | 我的自画像
item.description: this is me and my house. i love my family. i'm about to go to school (yellow school bus arrives). | 我在我的家门前，我准备去上学啦。我爱我的家。

item.title: traveling snails | 蜗牛一家去爬山
item.description: the snail family wants to climb up the big mountain. daddy carries the baby brother. i (pink shell) walk on my own. mommy snail says 'Love You' | 蜗牛一家要去山顶旅行。爸爸背着弟弟，粉壳蜗牛自己努力往上爬。妈妈说 "爱你们！"

item.title: it's raining | 下雨了
item.description: mom takes me to the school bus stop on a rainy day. it's my first day of school! | 妈妈陪我站在雨里等校车，今天是我第一天上学！

item.title: exploding volcano | 火山喷发
item.description: the volcano is going to explode in 10 seconds, and the dinosaur will be extinct. | 火山10秒后就要喷发，然后恐龙就灭绝了。

item.title: waiting for spring | 等待春天
item.description: the two chicks are waiting for spring to happen. | 两只毛茸茸的小鸡数着新芽等待春天到来。

item.title: rainbow kittycorn | 彩虹猫角兽
item.description: rainbow kittycorn is a unicorn mermaid kitty. she's jumping out of the sea and swimming under. | 彩虹猫角兽是一条美人鱼。她在大海里跳来跳去。

item.title: cheersing | 干杯
item.description: mom and the baby are cheersing because they caught fish together. | 猫妈妈和猫宝宝一起捉了很多鱼，干杯！

item.title: stepping out of the house | 出门
item.description: i'm stepping out of the house to get some pets from the pet store. | 我出门去宠物商店买宠物了。

item.title: mooncake playhouse | 月饼游乐园
item.description: the cats are resting in the mooncake house | 猫咪们在月饼游乐园里休息。

item.title: three little pigs | 三只小猪
item.description: daddy pig brings food to mommy pig and the three little brothers. | 猪爸爸端来吃的给猪妈妈和小猪们吃。

item.title: ornament penguins | 圣诞树企鹅
item.description: three ornament penguins are watching the sky. one of them said 'look! how beautiful the butterflies are.' | 三只装饰企鹅跑下了圣诞树，他们仰头看着天上飞舞的蝴蝶。

item.title: self-portrait | 蓝头发的我
item.description: this is me wearing my pink glasses and purple sweatshirt. and i dyed my hair blue. | 我戴着粉色眼镜，穿着紫色上衣，头发染成了蓝色。

item.title: tai and her three cats | Tai和她的三只猫
item.description: tai's cats are trying to touch the stars | Tai的猫咪们想要去摘星星。

item.title: bananas taking a bath | 香蕉洗澡
item.description: two bananas are taking a bath and playing with water. | 两根香蕉在澡盆里边泡澡边玩水。我很喜欢泡澡。

item.title: easter bunny | 复活节小兔
item.description: easter bunny giving eggs | 复活节小兔在分发彩蛋。

item.title: mermaids | 美人鱼
item.description: mermaid sisters swimming in the sea with their pet fish. | 美人鱼姐妹在大海里和她们的宠物鱼玩耍。

item.title: sunflower | 向日葵
item.description: sunflowers blooming in the summer | 向日葵在夏天盛开着。

item.title: the bunny family | 兔子一家
item.description: the bunny family is going out for flower picking. | 兔子爸爸，兔子妈妈，兔子姐姐和兔子宝宝出门去摘花。

item.title: the weird skeleton heads | 奇怪的骷髅头
item.description: the skeletons are having a party. | 骷髅头开派对。

item.title: mice eating pumpkins | 老鼠吃南瓜
item.description: mice are happy because they have lots of pumpkins to eat. | 老鼠们很开心，它们有好多南瓜可以吃。

item.title: mushroom house | 蘑菇屋
item.description: i'm hanging clothes in front of my mushroom house. | 我在我的蘑菇屋前晾衣服。

item.title: hamburger | 汉堡包
item.description: three hamburgers. one for dad, one for mom and one for me. | 一人一个汉堡包。

item.title: banana ballerinas | 香蕉跳芭蕾舞
item.description: there are three banana ballerinas. one of them fell, and two ran to help. | 有一只摔倒了，另外两只去帮忙。

item.title: nora on the swing | 荡秋千的瓜瓜
item.description: I'm swinging. | 我在荡秋千。

item.title: dancer | 舞者
item.description: she's dancing. | 她在跳舞。

item.title: penguin | 企鹅
item.description: my penguin toy. | 我的企鹅玩偶。
